claim: There was only a single species of middle to late Pleistocene NWSL equid.

claim: The family Equidae has a ~55 million year evolutionary history.

claim: Equidae evolved from dog-sized hyracotheres to present-day Equus.
source: The excellent fossil record of this family clearly documents its ~55 million year evolution from dog-sized hyracotheres through many intermediate forms and extinct offshoots to present-day Equus
